name: Shree Rama Rama Rameti
text:
श्रीराम राम रामेति रमे रामे मनोरमे ।
सहस्रनाम तत्तुल्यं रामनाम वरानने ॥
meaning: Chanting Rama’s name is equal to reciting all the thousand names of Vishnu.
purpose: A Rama-name verse associated with the thousand names of Vishnu.
when: When there is little time: the name alone is enough.
source: Closing verses of the Vishnu Sahasranama
